stores.identity: Profile UUID, permission, app scope and optional target; no token in key or value
stores.authority: getOrLoad always calls the owning Permissions service; diagnostic cache entries never authorize a request
stores.invalidation: Local profile epochs fence overlapping mutations; shared role/permission edits clear diagnostic entries. invalidateAccountProfiles accepts a validated, deduplicated authoritative owned-profile set; callers must prove ownership.
stores.replicaBoundary: Replicas do not need broadcast delivery to deny a revoked permission: each authorization reads current owning-service state. No permission-service availability means no grant.

stores.authority: Temporary ordering state only; not a permission decision
stores.invalidation: Profile invalidation/clear changes generations; overlapping loaders repeat; idle entries released

stores.identity: Signed account/profile/app claims plus durable Authentication validation
stores.authority: AuthGuard verifies JWT then AuthCommands.Validate for cookie and bearer credentials, including optional identities on public routes
stores.invalidation: Current-token logout changes durable state, so independent Gateway instances reject the token; no Gateway authentication cache to flush

stores.authority: SocketSessionAuthService revalidates durable token state; Social/Chat use it on relevant subscriptions/delivery/operations
stores.invalidation: Existing scoped socket access controls remain; N02 does not claim a new live Socket.IO/browser qualification

stores.identity: Account UUID and selected profile UUID; signed app claim
stores.authority: Existing credential ledger, not a permission cache. OAuth reference resolution checks row ID/account/profile/revoked flag, signed claims, guardian access and current Profile ownership.
stores.invalidation: Logout revokes a session. Permanent account-wide producer/session deletion fencing remains D00; never serialize credentials into operation ledgers or portability artifacts.

storage: bounded local maps in explicit development/test
stores.identity: One-time state ID, provider/app/return origin, browser nonce hash; optional authenticated account-link ID
stores.authority: PKCE and purpose-bound registration context, including guardian resume context, are protocol secrets; state is not an authenticated session. Ten-minute TTL and signed state/nonce validation apply.
stores.invalidation: Provider cancellation consumes state. Account invalidation removes linked states in the bounded managed index. Pre-login state has no established account association and expires; do not infer ownership.

storage: bounded local maps in explicit development/test
Redis with TTL and atomic redemption
stores.identity: Opaque durable session-row reference, account/profile/app and origin/state/nonce binding
stores.authority: No session bearer token is written to a new transient callback grant. Authentication resolves the reference only after Gateway consumes the bound one-time grant, and rechecks current session/profile authority.
stores.invalidation: Sixty-second producer TTL; replay and legacy raw-token grants rejected. Account invalidation removes matched managed grants without touching counterpart grants. Legacy unindexed grants expire under their original TTL and cannot redeem.

exclusions.reason: Browser/local persisted state and account-switch cleanup remain the existing N06 slice; no new UI or storage behavior here.
Permanent account-wide fencing, profile discovery and account deletion orchestration remain D00 and its scoped adapters. Internal invalidation methods do not expose public deletion.
No real OAuth provider handshake, inbox flow, deployed replica topology or production retention qualification.

runtimeProviderBoundary: Private case covers independent memory permission caches and shared Redis OAuth state with real Authentication/Profile/Permissions and PostgreSQL. It does not instantiate the file diagnostic cache provider or a full production Gateway deployment.
